options.title: Christmas at the Movies
options.source: Joe's sermon series email (Nov 17), Weekly Guide (invite cards from Nov 29)
options.why: Series launch day and invite cards hit the lobby today. Best invite window of the year.
bullets: Today we're starting a new series called Christmas at the Movies, where each week we'll take a classic Christmas film and look at what it says about the bigger story of Jesus.
Over the next four Sundays we'll walk through Polar Express, The Santa Clause, The Family Man, and The Best Christmas Pageant Ever.
If you have a friend who loves these movies but wouldn't usually come to church, this is about as easy an invitation as you'll ever get.
There are invite cards in the lobby, so grab a few on your way out and hand one to someone this week.
flags: Joe's doc says "The Greatest Christmas Pageant Ever." The movie is "The Best Christmas Pageant Ever." I used the real title.

options.title: Turn the Tide Christmas gifts
options.when: Tags out Nov 29 and Dec 6, gifts back by Sunday, December 13
options.why: Tags go out this Sunday. Knox County impact, whole church can do it.
bullets: There are kids in our community who won't find much under the tree this year unless someone steps in to help.
We're teaming up with Interchurch's Turn the Tide program, and starting today you can pick up a gift tag with a real child's Christmas wish written on it.
Grab a tag on your way out, and as long as the gift is back here by Sunday, December 13, it'll make it to that family in time for Christmas.
flags: Where are the tags (Connection Center)? I left the location out.
The newsletter also mentions grocery bags for local students. I left that out to keep it to one ask. Add it if you want.

options.title: Christmas Experience
options.source: Church newsletter, Planning Center calendar, Weekly Guide, Christmas Experience slide
options.why: Church-wide family event two weeks out. Good time to get it on calendars.
bullets: If your December is already filling up with shopping and errands, here's one evening that's actually about slowing down together.
The Christmas Experience is Sunday, December 13, at 6 PM in the Family Life Center, with music, treats, and hot drinks for the whole family.
It's an easy night to invite a neighbor to, so put it on your calendar now and think about who you could bring along.
flags: The newsletter also asks for cookie bakers (3 dozen, drop off Dec 11 or 13). Could be its own ask on Dec 6.

options.title: Next Step U: SHAPEd for Ministry
options.why: Sign-up class two weeks out. Could also wait a week and run Dec 6.
bullets: A lot of people want to serve but aren't sure where they'd fit, and that's exactly what SHAPEd for Ministry is designed to help you figure out.
In one short class you'll look at your gifts, passions, personality, and experiences, and start to see how God has wired you to make a difference.
It's on Sunday, December 13, right after the second and third services, and you can sign up through the Next Steps form using the QR code in front of you.
